summary: The proposed patch introduces redundant code and may not fully resolve the issue.

issues.description: The patch includes redundant calls to `self._set_parameters(best_params)`, `self.n_iter_ = best_n_iter`, and `self.lower_bound_ = max_lower_bound` which are already set earlier in the method.
There are no additional tests added to verify that the fix resolves the issue with `predict` and `fit_predict` disagreement when `n_init > 1`.
